origin.description: Draws one line per species against the grid, or against the box index.
origin.usage: plot(x, ..., which = NULL, grid = NULL, xyswap = FALSE)

arguments.name: grid
arguments.text: Horizontal coordinates. The default is 1, 2, ..., n.

origin.details: The line is (grid, state). A missing grid is the row number. which is 1-based.
origin.value: A figure. The coordinates are the grid and the species values.
origin.example:
out <- steady.1D(y = c(0.2, 0.2), func = function(t, y, p) list(c(y[2] - y[1], 1 - y[2])), nspec = 1)
plot(out, type = "l")

translation.description: Draws one line per species against the grid, or against the box index.

arguments.name: grid
arguments.text: Horizontal coordinates. The default is 1, 2, ..., n.

translation.details: The line is (grid, state). A missing grid is the row number. which is 1-based.
translation.value: A figure. The coordinates are the grid and the species values.
translation.example:
from rootSolve import plot_steady1d, steady_1d

def g(t, y, p):
    return [[y[1] - y[0], 1 - y[1]]]

out = steady_1d([0.2, 0.2], func=g, nspec=1)
plot_steady1d(out)
